title: Love it... looks and works great
text: Love it... looks and works great. This is the little yellow toaster that could. I love it and it looks great sitting on my counter!

product_metadata.title: iSiLER 2 Slice Toaster, 1.3 Inches Wide Slot Bagel Toaster with 7 Shade Settings and Double Side Baking, Compact Bread Toaster with Removable Crumb Tray, Defrost Cancel Function Pink
features: 2 Slice Extra-wide Slots & 750 W Power: Each slot measures 5.4 × 1.3”, accommodating thick slices of many types of bread, bagel, muffins, waffles and more. The high power of 750 W shortens the toast duration which greatly save energy, delivering a crispy outside without drying out the inside of the toast.

Even Browning With 7 Shade Settings & Double Sides Baking: The 7 selectable browning levels for 2-side baking allow optimal crispness for every type of bread and ensure even browning with precise control. The selectable toasting durations are between 55 to 175 seconds.
3 Led Function Buttons: The defrost and reheat mode avoid over-browning or burning. The cancel button allows a shutdown without a hassle. LED lights conveniently indicate all function buttons.

Easy Operation & Cleaning: Simply slide out the crumb tray for easy cleaning. The 3.6 foot extra-long cord provides greater reach with a convenient cord storage at the bottom of the unit. We provide a cleaning brush with the product.
Safety & Certification: Fast-heated stainless steel bread slots and a PP body provide optimal, UL certified safety.
